mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sys_user AS sys_user where sys_user.username = #{username} AND sys_user.del_flag = '0'

SELECT
FROM sys_user AS sys_user where sys_user.phone = #{phone} AND sys_user.del_flag = '0'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sys_user.id) FROM sys_user AS sys_user INNER JOIN sys_user_role AS sys_user_role ON sys_user_role.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sys_user_role.del_flag = '0' AND sys_user_role.user_id = sys_user.id INNER JOIN sys_role_menu AS sys_role_menu ON sys_role_menu.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sys_role_menu.role_id = sys_user_role.role_id INNER JOIN sys_menu ON sys_menu.id = sys_role_menu.menu_id AND sys_menu.del_flag = '0' WHERE sys_user.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sys_user.id = #{staffId} AND sys_user.del_flag = '0' AND sys_user.status = '0' AND sys_menu.permission IN ('message:service:agent', 'message:service:supervisor')
